title: Text-to-Speech Synthesis
description: Synthesizes spoken audio from provided text

speed.description: Optional speech speed multiplier (default 0.9 for Vietnamese)

noise_scale.description: Optional generator noise scale (default 0.667 for Piper TTS)

noise_w.description: Optional phoneme width noise scale (default 0.85 for Piper TTS)

pauses.description: Optional custom pause durations in seconds for punctuation: comma, period, question, exclamation, ellipsis, paragraph

reference_audio.description: Optional relative path to reference audio in workspace for voice cloning

output_path.description: Relative output path in workspace for wav/mp3 file

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the generated audio in seconds including pauses
